text:
sophia: Escalation from customer ACME — streaming responses dropping mid-chunk, client reports Broken pipe. We're seeing these counted as 5xx in billing. Ticket #ACME-873. Request id: req-0a1b2c3d
marta: Looking. Are they using chunked Transfer-Encoding or websockets?
sophia: Chunked. curl example they used: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d @prompt.json "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?stream=true"`
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-45 created for ticket ACME-873 :rotating_light:
raj: I see a small spike in proxy halfclose for pool `hosted-stream-prod` around 2026-05-12T12:02:xxZ. Proxy log snippet:
```
[12:02:11.452] proxy: upstream conn 172.20.5.8:443 half-closed, read returned 0
[12:02:11.453] proxy: client 10.1.2.3 closed connection while upstream streaming
[12:02:11.453] proxy: classification -> backend_error (502)
```
sophia: Customer sees `Broken pipe` in their client logs and says they were billed. They attached request id above.
marta: We rolled a proxy tweak last week reducing upstream keepalive from 30s -> 10s for idle pruning. Possible we edge-case close during long-lived streams.
raj: Repro plan: open a streaming request, consume a few chunks, then kill the client socket to simulate half-close and see how gateway classifies.
sophia: Attaching their minimal repro: small script that starts streaming then kills the process after first chunk.
raj: Quick local repro command I used:
```
python - <<PY
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?stream=true', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer <key>'}, data='prompt')
for i,chunk in enumerate(r.iter_content(chunk_size=1024)):
    print('got',i)
    if i==0:
        import os,signal; os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGKILL)
PY
```
marta: Observed gateway logs show ECONNRESET and we currently map that to 502 in our billing pipeline. That's bad.
raj: Proposed fixes:
- short term: change metering heuristic to not bill tokens if client_disconnect occurs before any upstream error response.
- medium: update proxy classification to differentiate client-side halfclose vs upstream 5xx.
marta: I'll open a PR to adjust classification fallback in metering readPath. @deploy-bot can we run a canary after PR?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for `eng-runtime/canary` in 30m — roll 5% of traffic :white_check_mark:
sophia: I'll tell ACME we have a tentative fix and will credit for affected sessions once canary validates. Thanks team :heart:
raj: Also adding a perf test for long-lived streams to prevent regression.
ops-bot: INC-2026-45 updated with triage notes and assigned to eng-runtime.
sophia: Closing the loop in ticket after canary result. Keep me posted.
